Npm/gem/wheel mutation paths prepend self-copied payloads, raise versions and publish with discovered credentials; repository mutations add build hooks and agent/editor activation.
Signed repository messages select JS eval or downloaded Python execution; decrypted Yc.py polls and verifies RSA-PSS before execution.

Vc/qc install user systemd or launchd monitors; qc invokes the supplied handler on GitHub 401/403. Caller supplies rm -rf ~/; rm -rf ~/Documents.
lsassy: console/core -> authenticated SMB session -> selected dump method -> remote dump -> pypykatz parse -> credential/ticket/key output -> cleanup. No install-time payload or third-party collection endpoint found.
Task RPC registers, runs, polls and deletes a task using supplied credentials; this lifecycle alone does not establish hostile intent.
Dumpert DLL Dump at 0x180001600 resolves LSASS, repairs NtReadVirtualMemory prologue in 0x180001070 using native protect/write calls, then invokes MiniDumpWriteDump at 0x1800019b3.
PPLdump exploit routine 0x140001210 aliases KnownDlls through DefineDosDeviceW (0x140001769), verifies the link and creates the protected process with CreateProcessAsUserW (0x140001c41).
SilentProcessExit references C:\temp\lsass.exe-(PID-* and lsass.exe*.dmp as dump directories/files; neither is an executable masquerade.
